$Comment: Off-hand utility item, not a shield: only the icon is the vanilla mithril shield's. Model: a 1-unit amber dot under an L-Attachment node, so that nothing noticeable is drawn in the hand (tools/assets/make_holtzman.js). No Primary, no Secondary, no Weapon block, no guard interactions: it has no interaction of its own, and its OffHand priorities are -1 so that the main-hand item always keeps both clicks (see InteractionContext.forInteraction: with equal priorities a Utility.Compatible main-hand item such as a sword would hand its right click to the off-hand item, which has no Secondary, and the guard would be lost). PlayerAnimationsId Default is the animation set of an empty hand (first-person idle/walk only, no third-person poses), so the left arm is not posed. What it does is in the Holtzman system (the field, with the entity effect Arrakis_Holtzman_Field) and the damage system (projectile damage taken out of Arrakis_Power).
